about_short_description.short_description: AI Powered Operations and Supply Chain Software Platform for Retail, Commerce & Logistics.

product.name: Order Management System
product.description: Manages and streamlines order processing from inception to delivery, supporting multichannel sales and real-time inventory synchronization.

product.name: Warehouse Management System
product.description: Optimizes warehouse operations with real-time inventory tracking, storage management, and compliance features across multiple locations.

product.name: Transportation Management System
product.description: Manages logistics and transportation workflows including trip planning, driver management, route optimization, and real-time shipment tracking.

product.name: Point of Sale System
product.description: Enables secure and efficient transaction processing with cash handling, tax automation, and real-time inventory updates.

product.name: OmniShip Multi-Carrier Shipping Platform
product.description: Aggregates multiple shipping carriers to manage shipments across all logistics stages with real-time tracking and rule-based automation.

product.name: Inventory Management System
product.description: Provides real-time stock control, automated replenishment, and inventory synchronization across multiple locations and sales channels.
